item.title: Frederic Wandres Triumphs in Freestyle and Kevin Kohmann Secures World Cup Final Start
item.description: Olympian Frederic Wandres (GER) rode Verrenberg to the top prize, while Kevin Kohmann (USA) and Dünensee qualified for their third consecutive FEI Dressage World Cup™ Final.

item.title: Justin Verboomen and Zonik Plus Claim Thrilling Victory in Final World Cup Qualifier
item.description: After a dynamite freestyle, Belgium's Justin Verboomen narrowly beats out Charlotte Fry (GBR) to take top honors at the final qualifier of the FEI Dressage World Cup Western European League in ‘s-Hertogenbosch.

item.title: Is Your Dressage Horse Getting His Daily Salt Requirements?
item.description: Most horses don't receive adequate amounts of this key but underestimated mineral. Learn why salt is essential to your horse's health and performance, the signs he might be deficient and how you can easily add sodium to his diet.

item.title: Dressage Today Podcast: Anne Mouen Stahl, Our First Hometown Hero
item.description: In this episode, Stephany and Aviva interview Anne Mouen Stahl. The longtime trainer and coach talks about her thoughtful, progressive approach to training and how she helps her students gain a better understanding of the fundamental dressage principles.

item.title: Training the Happy Dressage Athlete with JJ Tate
item.description: Team Prac member and international dressage rider JJ Tate explains how you can foster a happy training environment for your dressage horse by teaching him to love learning.

item.title: Creative Cavalletti for Improved Balance, Rhythm and Gait Quality
item.description: Teaching your dressage horse how to navigate ground poles and cavalletti provides many benefits to his training and will make him an overall more attentive, athletic horse. Get started with these exercises from Michele Wellman.

item.title: Eight of the World's Top 20 Dressage Riders Top Entry List for World Cup Final
item.description: Check out the impressive list of talented dressage riders who will be vying for top honors at the 2026 Zen Elite FEI Dressage World Cup™ Final in Fort Worth, Texas, from April 8-12.

item.title: US Equestrian Announces USA Dressage Combinations to Compete at 2026 FEI World Cup™ Finals Fort Worth
item.description: Find out more about the USA Dressage pairs who will compete in the 2026 FEI World Cup™ Finals hosted in Fort Worth, Texas.

item.title: Loosen Up to Improve Your Position—and Ride Better!
item.description: Is your desk job sabotaging your position? Shannon Peters explains why sitting for too long weakens your position and restricts your ability to follow your horse and offers exercises to help you loosen up to rider better.

item.title: 2 Leg-Yielding Exercises for Your Young Horse
item.description: Practice these leg-yielding exercises to move your horse away from your inside leg and introduce him to diagonal aids.
